display_name: DURA 对同源 IQ 三种模拟信道的误差分解
description: 对 672 条合法源 IQ 的三个固定模拟视图计算 DURA 波形误差的有限三视图均值项与离散项，不训练或读取 F、TX、V、目标。
authorization: 用户继续授权研发星地恢复网络；仅源域合法 IQ 诊断，不重启已停止任务。

code.environment: N607 CPU FP32 TF32 off, batch8, 2 threads, CUDA hidden

data.contract_ref: docs/PROJECT_PROTOCOL.md: 恢复器主测试口径及源数据权限
data.physical_ids_ref: 672 fixed source pilot physical IDs each with three matching simulated observations

roles.L_s: source IQ pair, no TX identity
roles.U_s: source IQ pair, TX identity hidden

data.validation_ref: Previously explored fixed source pilot; RX8 is source held group, not independent to DURA

permissions.claim_scope: Exploratory finite three-view source IQ decomposition; not identity or independent target performance

checkpoint.contract_check_ref: frozen_dura validates original7/63/30 and source-only checkpoint; fresh source cache shared physical IDs
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Fixed source-only DURA, no F or target ancestry
checkpoint.selection_rule: Fixed original DURA, no target selection

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only, 2 threads, CUDA hidden; preserve all other owners
execution.stop_rule: Stop on source role mismatch, source smoke failure, nonfinite output or any target/F/TX read; preserve stopped group and other owners.

expected_artifacts: result.json per-RX and clean-count groups of finite three-view source IQ decomposition

metric_names: squared error of finite three-view mean
dimensions: RX4/6 and RX8, clean view count

rows.method: Frozen DURA per physical source IQ across three fixed simulated observations
rows.purpose: Assess channel-dependent source error variability for possible cross-view training
rows.seed_notes: Existing pretrained source runs and fixed source pilots; no stochastic training, support or augmentation in this benchmark.
rows.scenario: three source simulated views at epochs 21,22,23
rows.budget_ref: 672 source IQ x 3 views; CPU batch8

notes: Per-record squared mean error plus finite-view dispersion equals average source IQ NMSE; it is not an irreducible bias estimate.
Averaging three outputs is an unavailable-view oracle, not a deployable proposal or identity metric.
Source data were explored and DURA may have seen corresponding source domains. No F/TX/V/target reads.
